config.title: Archive Configuration
config.summaryDescription: Configure cloud and local paths in the settings subpage.
config.settingsDescription: Set the cloud archive location, local cache, capacity limit, volume size, and 7z path here.
config.autoImportNewGames: Automatically prompt Cloud Archive for newly imported games
config.autoImportNewGamesDescription: When enabled, newly imported games from the home import flow will prompt you to add them to Cloud Archive. Large games can take a while and use local cache and cloud archive space.

empty.title: No Games
empty.description: Games will appear here after the library database is loaded.

notifications.loadFailed: Failed to load cloud archive data: {{message}}
notifications.saveFailed: Failed to save cloud archive configuration: {{message}}
notifications.downloadBeforeStart: This game is archived in the cloud. Download it to local cache before starting.
notifications.waitForSyncing: This game is busy with a cloud archive task. Please wait for it to finish.
notifications.archivePathMissing: This game does not have a cloud archive path yet.
notifications.gameRunning: The game is running, so this cloud archive action is disabled.

datesheet.title: Datesheet Health
datesheet.cleanupConfirmDescription: Only clean it after confirming no cloud archive task is running. After cleanup, save settings again or retry the cloud archive action.
datesheet.nonEmptyMissing: This directory already has content but no Vnite datesheet. Confirm it is the directory you want to use for cloud archive before initializing.
datesheet.initializeConfirmDescription: Vnite will write paired datesheet files to the local cache and cloud archive roots to identify this cloud archive pair.
datesheet.initializeNonEmptyConfirmDescription: At least one selected directory already has content but no Vnite datesheet. This will only write datesheet marker files and will not delete existing files; confirm the selected local cache and cloud archive directories are correct.

errors.pathEmpty: Set both cloud and local paths first.
errors.sameRoot: Cloud archive and local cache cannot be the same directory.
errors.datesheetMissing: Datesheet is missing. Save settings to initialize it.
errors.recoveredFromBackup: Datesheet official file is corrupted. Restore the backup before continuing.
errors.pairMismatch: Local and cloud datesheets do not belong to the same pair.
errors.roleMismatch: This directory has the wrong datesheet role.
errors.schemaUnsupported: This datesheet is from an unsupported version.
errors.lockBusy: Datesheet is locked by another operation.
errors.lockTimeout: Datesheet has an expired lock. Clean it after confirming no task is running.
errors.archivePartsMissing: Cloud archive parts are missing. Cloud sync may not have finished.
errors.archivePartsMismatch: Cloud archive parts do not match the datesheet.
errors.localLimitExceeded: Local cache capacity is not enough.
errors.diskSpaceInsufficient: Disk free space is not enough.
errors.sevenZipMissing: 7-Zip was not found. Install 7-Zip or set a custom path.
errors.invalidGameId: This game ID cannot be safely used as a cloud archive directory name. Check the game data or wait for a compatibility migration.
errors.sevenZipInvalid: The custom 7-Zip path is invalid. Choose a valid 7z.exe or clear the field to use the system 7-Zip.
